definition.simple: Convection is when heat travels because the hot liquid or gas itself moves, like hot air rising from a heater.
definition.academic: Convection is the transfer of heat by the physical movement of a fluid (liquid or gas) between areas of different temperatures.

common_misconceptions: Thinking convection can happen in solids. (Solids can't flow, so convection can't happen there).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind them 'Hot air is lighter and goes up, cold air is heavier and comes down!'
